inferential_decision: Adding 4305 genuinely classified dated original historical photos increases date-resolved taxonomic breadth from 2007 to 5315 named taxa (3308 more), but adds zero independent same taxon/coarse-site/local-season-year summer-winter repeated photo groups under either one or two original observations per season.
limitations: Photo/date and four hue outcome are source records; open flower organs not independently botanically confirmed.
Substantially greater taxonomic breadth can support global source-composition work but cannot infer local seasonal pigment plasticity from cross-site species turnover.
A nominal 0.25-degree cell covers tens of kilometres and is not a breeding population; same observation ID vs independent photographer issues remain.
Provider current observed-on date is editable metadata, not verified EXIF/camera timestamp.
Full 100543-photo restoration and calendar-year-specific climate conditions are separate not-yet-confirmed analyses.
FCP within-species W/D local polymorphism and annual genus maxT original moisture effect have not been changed.
